documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Disclosures under Reg. 29(2) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011
Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations 2015- ESG Rating

analysis.summary: Mayur Uniquoters Limited reported its Q1 FY27 financial results during the earnings conference call, registering standalone revenue of INR247.03 crores and consolidated revenue of INR269.23 crores. Management highlighted that the growth was driven primarily by mix changes and export performance, despite challenges like raw material price volatility and increased freight costs. The company is proceeding with an internal line expansion slated to start production by early 2027 while keeping international expansion plans under evaluation due to market uncertainties. Mayur Uniquoters reported a strong performance for Q4 and FY '26, driven by higher contributions from export businesses, particularly automotive OEMs, and favorable currency movements. Management stated that availability issues for key raw materials like paste PVC have been resolved, though petroleum-based prices have risen.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the present quarter's margin is sustainable and expected to continue.
guidance.quote: But this present quarter's margin will be sustainable and expected to continue.

guidance.claim: Management expects domestic growth between 8%-10% and export growth between 15%-20%.
guidance.quote: our expectation from domestic growth is between 8%-10%. And our expectation from export growth is from 15%-20%.

guidance.claim: Management stated that value growth will be much higher than volume growth due to higher export prices and targeted high-value domestic items.
guidance.quote: obviously, the value growth will be much more than the volume growth because our export prices are much more higher. And in the domestic industry also, what type of business that we are targeting, we are not targeting a very low-priced item. We are targeting a much more higher-value items. So, we see more value growth than we see in volume growth.

guidance.claim: Management expects the growth momentum in US export OEM supply to continue in the next 2-3 years.
guidance.quote: And in addition to this, we have already received some good export orders from US for OEM supply which are making a good contribution to our self-revenue and profitability. And this increased momentum is expected to continue in the next 2-3 years.

guidance.claim: The company has kept a potential outlook for a 15% growth in the coming year.
guidance.quote: So we have kept potential outlook for 15% growth in the coming year also.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the value is expected to grow by 15% for the next two years with margins remaining at more or less similar levels.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the footwear market was muted due to a drastic increase in raw material and sole prices.
demand_outlook.quote: So obviously, the market was muted in the footwear segment.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that European market sentiments are positive regarding the recent FTA signed by India.
demand_outlook.quote: I think so it's a very positive move for India. Definitely, we will be more effective in terms of cost. The sentiments of the customers to procure from India will definitely increase. So and definitely both especially in the Europe market, I mean very good sentiments are coming.

demand_outlook.claim: Automotive sector is driving more growth in both domestic and international markets.
demand_outlook.quote: Obviously, we are focusing more on the automotive sector. So, we see more growth coming from the automotive side, whether it's in the domestic market or in the international market.

demand_outlook.claim: PU business is still muted and business has not matured till now despite vendor approval from a big customer.
demand_outlook.quote: So, PU, still the business is muted right now. We have not been able to succeed too much in terms of the volume in PU and increasing in sales. But definitely as we have highlighted in the previous call also, we are definitely talking to a lot of brands. But business has not matured till now. In fact, there was an audit from a very big customer. They have passed us, approved us as a vendor. But no price commercial settlement has happened till now.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the Footwear business is not growing due to local competition and low price margins.
demand_outlook.quote: Our Footwear business is not growing because of local competition, because of price -- low price margin.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the European automotive industry is experiencing a story of degrowth.
demand_outlook.quote: But if you see, European automotive industry is not growing as much rather than it's -- there is a story of degrowth over there.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that plasticizer and yarn prices have started going up.
demand_outlook.quote: In fact, plasticizers prices have started going up. Yarn prices have started going up.

capex_expansion.claim: The company ordered a line for expansion in its current premises to start production between February and March 2027.
capex_expansion.quote: So we should be able to start our production by -- towards the end of this financial year, somewhere between February, March 2027.

capex_expansion.claim: The upcoming expansion line will add an additional production capacity of 5 lakh meters.
capex_expansion.quote: So we'll have an additional production capacity of 5 lakh meters.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that the capex for financial year 2026-2027 is around INR50 crores.
Instead of putting the newly ordered coating line in South India, the company found space in an existing facility to increase capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: In India, we have ordered a coating line. But instead of putting it in South India, we have found space in an existing facility only. So, we will put it here. So, our capacity will increase. But we are not putting it in South India. We are putting it here.

capex_expansion.claim: The ordered coating line at the existing location should be done by the end of the calendar year.
capex_expansion.quote: We have already ordered for an existing location. So, by the end of this calendar year, it should be done. Maybe 1 month plus or minus.

capex_expansion.claim: If the capex is done in the South, it will be approximately INR 200 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: So if we are evaluating which one we have to go for first. But if we do in South, it's approximately INR200 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: If capex is done on a global scale, it will be INR 300 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: If we do on a global scale, it will be INR300 crores over there.

capex_expansion.claim: Once the decision for the South plant is taken, it takes approximately 2 years for the plant to start.
capex_expansion.quote: So once the decision is taken, it takes approximately 2 years for the plant to start.

capex_expansion.claim: The South plant will start with an initial capacity of 500,000 millimetres per month.
capex_expansion.quote: And we will start with 500,000 millimetres per month initially.

margins_costs.claim: Management reported that shipping costs for exports increased 4x in the last quarter.
margins_costs.quote: It's 4x higher, the shipment cost was increased.

margins_costs.claim: Management explained that raw material prices went up sharply, followed by a fall and subsequent increases, creating a volatile situation.
margins_costs.quote: The prices went up very sharply, then there was a fall in prices of some raw materials. Then again, the prices went up again. So, it's been a very volatile situation.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material prices for paste PVC have gone up significantly as a petroleum by-product, but availability is not an issue right now.
margins_costs.quote: So, obviously, it's a petroleum by-product. So, the prices have gone up and the prices have gone up significantly. So, there was a challenge initially in the month of March where people were expecting that there could be an issue regarding the availability of the raw material. But I think those issues are resolved now. And prices have also softened a little bit from the highs of March. It's softened a little bit. But availability is not an issue right now.

margins_costs.claim: Short-term impact on margins occurs due to the time taken to pass on price increases, but inventory averaging helps in the long term.
margins_costs.quote: Short-term, yes, maybe a month or so. Because it takes some time to pass on the price increase to the customers. Definitely, it impacts a little bit in the short-term. But we do carry some inventory also. So, it gets averaged out in the long-term.

margins_costs.claim: Other expenses decreased in the quarter due to lower freight costs and controlled maintenance and repair costs.
margins_costs.quote: Our freight cost has gone down in this quarter because of this war situation and all and second one our maintenance cost repair and maintenance cost and consumables were also controlled and because of these two reasons our other income reduced

margins_costs.claim: Stand-alone revenue increased by 22% while PBT and PAT increased by 71% and 77% respectively on a Y-o-Y basis.
margins_costs.quote: In the quarter, the stand-alone revenue increased by 22% and PBT and PAT both increased by 71% and 77% on Y-o-Y basis.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated revenue increased by 14% and PBT and PAT increased by 58% and 66%.
margins_costs.quote: In this quarter, the consolidated revenue increased by 14% and PBT and PAT increased by 58% and 66%.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that imports account for nearly one-third of total raw material costs.
margins_costs.quote: Normally, imports are nearly 1/3 of our total raw material cost.

margins_costs.claim: Around 50% of other income for the quarter came from foreign exchange gain and the remaining from treasury income.
margins_costs.quote: This quarter, other income has the major part of foreign exchange gain around 50% and remaining is our treasury income.

orders_capacity.claim: Current capacity utilization of existing capacity is between 75% and 78%.
orders_capacity.quote: So, we are utilizing somewhere between 75% to 78%.

orders_capacity.claim: Total export sales for Q1 FY27 stood at INR103.80 crores and domestic sales at INR143.23 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Export general 30.24, export OEM 73.56, total exports is INR103.80 crores, auto OEM domestic 56.08, replacement, 36.52, footwear 41.16, furnishing 6.08 and other 3.38 and total domestic sale is 143.23.

orders_capacity.claim: Total volume sold in FY '26 was 31 million meters, representing a volume growth of approximately 5%.
orders_capacity.quote: Volume growth is a total 4.5%. Nearly 5%.

orders_capacity.claim: The new coating line capacity is expected to average roughly 5 lakh meters monthly.
orders_capacity.quote: Generally average is 5 lakh meter monthly. It is rough calculation, it could be 4 and 6 too, but average will be that. So, revenue will increase by INR 120 Cr. – INR 150 Cr.

orders_capacity.claim: Total volume for the quarter has been 76.3 lakh meters, including PU volume of 2.56 lakh meters.
orders_capacity.quote: Total volume has been 76.3 lakh meters, including PU, which has been 2.56 lakh meters for the quarter and value 6.17.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management cited market volatility and the West Asia war as uncontrollable factors affecting business.
risks_headwinds.quote: No one knows what will happen with the West Asia war tomorrow. Things look very stable right now. So obviously, whatever projections we give, we give based on our normal market situations. Certain situations are not in our control, which we cannot predict right now.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management highlighted that international plant expansion decisions are delayed due to market volatility, Trump tariffs, and the West Asia war.
risks_headwinds.quote: But because of all this Trump tariff, the West Asia war or multiple things happening in the last few years, we have not taken a final call where -- which should be the ideal location to put our plant.

risks_headwinds.claim: External factors such as war situations and US duties previously impacted general export dispatches and expected increases.
risks_headwinds.quote: Because there was some material that was supposed to go to the Middle East, but we could not dispatch that material, it was on hold. Secondly, if you remember, when the US tariff came, our general export business did not go down. But because we had started our business in Europe also, we had said that our business has not gone down, but the increase that we were expecting in general export, that had to get nullified.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that the world is moving towards deglobalization as a reason for evaluating plants outside India.
risks_headwinds.quote: But world is moving towards deglobalization also. So as a counter measure, those things we are evaluating to put up a plant somewhere, not taking a final call there, but somewhere outside India definitely.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that production from the new line in current premises will start between February and March 2027.
management_commitments.quote: So we should be able to start our production by -- towards the end of this financial year, somewhere between February, March 2027.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to maintain the growth momentum in the export business over the next 2-3 years.
management_commitments.quote: And in addition to this, we have already received some good export orders from US for OEM supply which are making a good contribution to our self-revenue and profitability. And this increased momentum is expected to continue in the next 2-3 years.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects the new coating line at the existing location to be completed by the end of this calendar year.
management_commitments.quote: We have already ordered for an existing location. So, by the end of this calendar year, it should be done. Maybe 1 month plus or minus.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the increased export momentum for OEM supply is expected to continue in the next 2 to 3 years.
management_commitments.quote: And this increased momentum is expected to continue in the next 2, 3 years.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
